item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Food is fuel, and your day has a lot of demands in it. Skipping meals makes everything harder, including patience and perspective. Eat something with protein within an hour of waking. Plan a real meal before the evening rush, not whatever is left over. Drink water between tasks. Keep it simple and repeatable. Action: right now, decide what your next meal is and put it on your list.
